items.originalTitle: Strumyani Cleanup Continues 10 Days After the Flood
items.originalExcerpt: Ten days after severe flooding hit Strumyani, cleanup and recovery efforts are continuing across the southwestern Bulgarian municipality, with homes, roads and public infrastructure still being cleared of mud, debris and fallen trees. Drinking water remains unavailable because of restrictions imposed by the Regional Health Inspectorate, but rail traffic through the area has now resumed. Specialists from the National Railway Infrastructure Company restored the railway connection in about a week, allowing trains traveling between Kulata and Sofia to pass through Strumyani again....
